notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q320967_akagi.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upright at about 5,490 m north-west of Midway: the bow driven deep into the seabed with the chrysanthemum crest, the flight deck and the burnt-out hangar fallen in, the island on the port side, the funnel curving down over the starboard side, the 20 cm casemate guns aft, debris along the port side. A war grave (267 died). The damage and the heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: the carrier as she was in 1942. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
